title: Google DeepMind says Genie 4 is available to eligible AI Ultra subscribers
summary: Google DeepMind announced that Genie 4, the latest version of its generative world model, is now available. According to the announcement as supplied, access is limited to "eligible Google AI Ultra subscribers," with no technical details on model capabilities, benchmarks, pricing, or supported regions. Commenters reported difficulty confirming eligibility, including a UK user whose Workspace account could not obtain Ultra and whose personal account indicated that Ultra includes Genie 3.
